sweeps.description: Vary the size of the shared bus pool while keeping demand, routes, sensor quality, and the nominal static timetable unchanged.
sweeps.name: fleet-pressure
sweeps.title: Fleet pressure

sweeps.description: Vary the expected number of unexpected station demand spikes per network-day. Internally this is converted to the equivalent per-station/day event probability.
sweeps.name: event-frequency
sweeps.title: One-off event frequency

sweeps.description: Vary Gaussian occupancy-estimation error while keeping reporting quantization fixed at 1 percentage point. Lower values mean more accurate station occupancy estimates.
sweeps.name: sensor-accuracy
sweeps.title: Occupancy estimation accuracy

sweeps.description: Vary independent sensor-packet loss. When a packet is lost, the server continues using the last successfully received occupancy reading until a newer packet arrives.
sweeps.name: packet-dropout
sweeps.title: Packet dropout

sweeps.description: Vary how Hybrid combines normalized historical-demand pressure and live sensor pressure. A sensor weight of 0 is history-only; 1 is sensor-only; intermediate values blend the two signals.
sweeps.name: hybrid-weight
sweeps.title: Hybrid sensor/history weight
sweeps.x_label: Hybrid sensor weight (history weight = 1 − sensor weight)
